value.rationale: A natural on-curve finite Fourier sampling problem has a sharp uniform full/half/one rank transition; the entire kernel and singular-value distribution clarify the precise effect of deleting the linear pairing. A reusable singleton-fiber cyclotomic criterion gives a nontrivial general structural sufficient condition. This is relevant to interpolating finite-curvature Fourier data and cannot be obtained merely by recomputing a published table.
